fixed_factors.flank_signature: positive transverse Hessian curvature times line anisotropy
fixed_factors.holdout_reuse_status: labels appeared in prior quadrant-aggregated H35-01/H35-02 summaries; nested folds are exploratory, not a pristine independent replication

rationale.max_scale_m: 200 to 1000 m Gaussian neighbourhoods on a 100 m grid; test local halo width without asserting a fault-scale optimum
rationale.flank_curvature_weight: 0 to 1 ablates versus emphasizes a two-flank trough shape using positive transverse curvature and Hessian line anisotropy
rationale.conductance_weight: 0 to 0.8 multiplicative corroboration from the provided shallow conductivity surface; this is an ablation-weight range, not a calibrated probability
rationale.gravity_edge_weight: 0 to 0.8 multiplicative corroboration from the provided isostatic gravity horizontal gradient
rationale.prediction_fraction: 0.4% to 1.2% of each fold's eligible area; selection uses only development-tile DTI and all comparisons re-emit at matched actual pixel mass
rationale.magnetic_source: balanced categorical comparison of supplied anomaly, RTP, and TMI bands; level counts are 3, 3, and 2
rationale.geometry: 3x2 spatial blocks with 30-pixel (3 km) edge margins; each outer tile is scored once after LHS selection on the other five
rationale.provenance: only existing supplied feature and label rasters are used; data are a public owner-maintained mirror, not organizer-authenticated
